value: a copy of your university entrance qualification
copies of your 3 most recent degrees (with certified translation, if the original language is not English, German or French; a recent transcript if the current degree is ongoing)
a certified list of all attended courses with the respective grades, including an explanation of the grading system
Curriculum Vitae (CV) including information on your areas of interest in research, as well as any projects or publications
two complete review forms by recommenders appointed by the applicant in the application system
personal statement written by the applicant
English certificate (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge or PTE; MOI not accepted)
APS certificate (degrees from China, India or Vietnam)
GRE General Test or GATE test result (degrees from outside the EHEA, Switzerland and the UK)

required_documents.reason: Draft lists only the transcript items; the guide also requires a CV, two recommender review forms, the English certificate, APS (China/India/Vietnam) and GRE/GATE (non-EHEA/CH/UK), and the programme page requires a personal statement.
